user.title: Art-Net LED UI Config
user.description: Adds the **Art-Net LED Config** panel to the sidebar. The panel writes a YAML file for [ha-artnet-led]({artnet_led_url}).

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.

data_description.include_file: File in the configuration directory that receives the generated `artnet_led` platforms, e.g. `ha_artnet_led_uiconfig.yaml`.

error.invalid_include_file: Use a relative path ending with .yaml or .yml inside the configuration directory (not configuration.yaml).

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
